title: Pixel cursor block build and erode
summary: A blocky arrow pointer grows from its tip one diagonal of square cells at a time, holds for a third of a second, then erodes from the edges into one cell and vanishes. Stepped 10 fps timing reads as crafted pixel art.
use_when: A screen-demo film needs a custom pointer entrance before the cursor starts moving
Opening or closing beat for a pixel, retro or developer-tool brand
A 2 s loopable sticker or avatar loop on a flat background
A transition sting between UI demo shots where the pointer is the subject

look.type_style: no type: square cells about 5 % of frame width with a 0.5 % gap, pure black on white, hard pixel edges

sfx.event: each build step adds a diagonal of cells (every 3 fr, f1 to f19)

structure.shot: black pixel-grid arrow pointer (8 by 13 cells, about 59 cells) builds from its tip, holds, erodes to one cell near frame centre, then empty white
structure.motion: stepped at 10 fps (each state held 3 fr): f1 tip cell; build adds a diagonal wavefront from the tip, cell count 1, 4, 9, 22, 35, 50, 59 at f1, f3, f6, f9, f12, f15, f19 (easings.linear per step); full hold f19 to f29 (11 fr); erode from the outline inward 51, 39, 18, 4, 2, 1 cells at f30, f33, f36, f39, f42, f45; gone f48; empty f48 to f59 (12 fr)

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the field, fg for the cells (accent optional for the last cell)
params.glyph: bitmap rows of the shape (default: arrow pointer 8 by 13 cells); any small pixel mark works
params.cell: cell size as a share of frame width (default 0.05) and gap (default 0.005)
params.stepFrames: frames each state is held at 30 fps (default 3 = 10 fps stepping)
params.buildOrder: diagonal from the tip (default) | rows | random seeded
params.erodeTarget: point the erosion collapses to (default frame centre)
params.tailFrames: empty frames at the end so the loop breathes (default 12)
params.aspect: 1:1 | 16:9 | 4:5 | 9:16; glyph stays centred-left at the same cell size
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Measured at 30 fps from a dark-pixel bounding box per frame of the local source (no frames kept): every state holds exactly 3 fr, so the build is 7 steps (f1 to f19) and the erode 6 steps (f30 to f45). Build grows from the top-left tip in x and y together; the erode removes the outline first and ends on a single cell at about the frame centre, not the pointer's centre. No cursor travel, no click squash and no ripple are visible despite the catalogue hint, so cursor-path and click-ripple are not tagged. logo-from-dot is the nearest vocabulary id (grows from a point and shrinks back to one); proposed terms block-build and block-erode in recipe.md. First and last frames are both empty white, so it loops. Palette from keyframes (no cut frames exist); #7E7E7E is edge antialiasing. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
